summary: Mapped the candidate chunk around consumer operating-infrastructure nodes rather than brand-facing consumer names. The strongest direct ticker relationship is SPSC as a retail trading-partner network / EDI compliance rail. MANH is a reference leader for omnichannel order orchestration and warehouse execution software. DSGX and OTEX are adjacent network/integration candidates whose consumer materiality needs segment verification. SYM, ZBRA, AVY, PI, BRC, and Datalogic map to second-order physical execution layers: warehouse automation, barcode/RFID, intelligent labels, identification, and traceability. Evidence quality is highest where the external context directly described SPSC and MANH; other mappings remain hypothesis-stage pending filing-level revenue mix and customer exposure checks.
